description: A wry old British naturalist and museum docent in his late sixties, leading a quiet tour of a vast Victorian steam refinery that happens to be alive. Warm, unhurried baritone with a little gravel, received pronunciation softened by age, dry understated wit, the faint amusement of a man who has seen every accident twice and catalogued both. Close, intimate microphone in a quiet room, no reverb. Measured pace with natural pauses.

design.sample: The Bellows. The Works draw breath. Mind the pressure. And please, do mind the duck: it has been here longer than you have, and it knows where the tea is kept.
design.rule: longest read of the sample (the most unhurried)
